en: A black-and-white photograph showing a group of soldiers in uniform, lying prone on the ground in a wooded area, apparently participating in a military training exercise. The soldiers are wearing pickelhaube helmets, distinctive to German military uniforms from the late 19th and early 20th centuries, and are armed with rifles. The background features birch trees and sparse undergrowth.
